column1: # AoE2 map_id -> name -> family -> notes. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH; the analyzer reads col1(id)+col3(family).
# Source: families classified from the Age of Empires Fandom wiki by real flank/pocket TEAM STRUCTURE
#   (not just terrain); gameplay map ids only (9..215). Arabia=9 verified vs a real replay.
# family enum (EDIT col 3): open | closed | hybrid | water | nomad | special | other
#   open/closed = flank/pocket coaching applies (open-land vs walled). hybrid/water/nomad/special/other = NO role tag.
